name: Baseline reproduction and provenance
hypothesis: Can a clean environment reproduce the archived metrics and establish a trustworthy starting point?
runs: 2026-10-09 clean uv.lock install, Python 3.13.5 and 3.12.10, tag v0.3.0-hackathon
result: Exact reproduction: identical dataset SHA-256 and identical detection metrics on both Python versions; 120/120 tests pass. See docs/research/reproduction/E01_v0.3.0_reproduction.md
limitations_observed: Score is predict_proba, not a vote fraction: 56 of 32,297 test decisions flip at 0.35 if read as votes
Python version not pinned by the lockfile
Model metadata stores data path, not data hash
Reproducibility shown on one machine and synthetic data only
selection_decision: Reference row for the P6 benchmark

name: Feature-group and leave-one-feature ablations
hypothesis: Which observable features add benefit beyond rules and which rely on artifacts?

name: Adapter and availability audit
hypothesis: Can each selected input be obtained causally at a real receiver, with correct units and missingness?

name: Classical algorithm benchmark
hypothesis: Which eligible model best trades detection, false alarms and edge cost?

name: Unknown attacks and temporal models
hypothesis: Do novelty/sequence methods help on truly unseen attack families?

name: Cross-domain generalization
hypothesis: How much do performance and calibration degrade across datasets, roads and receivers?

name: Connectivity, clock and GNSS impairment
hypothesis: Does benign degradation trigger false attack claims or break local detection?

name: Explanation fidelity and usefulness
hypothesis: Are attributions faithful, stable, timely and understandable?

name: Ledger comparison and failure campaign
hypothesis: What does multi-party consensus add beyond signed off-box checkpoints, at what cost?

name: Simulator parity and network effects
hypothesis: Does the selected simulator produce receiver traces with measured loss, timing and reproducible seeds?

name: App load, recovery and access control
hypothesis: Can a private staging service meet its declared workload and recover without losing acknowledged incidents?

name: CAN extension benchmark
hypothesis: Does a separate CAN adapter/model generalize beyond one recording?

name: Operator usability
hypothesis: Can operators investigate an alert and verify its evidence without confusing score, truth and commit state?
